notes: The payload of each state is what gets JSON.serialize'd into CustomerProfileCardData.profileJSON. The 'default' state is what CustomerProfileCardDemo returns. An optional 'photoUrl' key swaps the initials avatar for a real image; the sample states leave it out so the preview needs no network image.

states.label: Known customer
states.description: The main case: the agent resolved the customer and the whole profile is in front of the rep before they type a word.

states.label: At-risk customer
states.description: The same card under a different reading. Churn risk at or above 50 turns that metric red, and 'alertActive' raises a banner above the detail grid, so the rep sees the one thing they must not miss before they start talking.

payload.alertMessage: Renews in 12 days with two reopened cases this month.

states.label: No profile found
states.description: The identifier the agent had matched nothing. Worth designing deliberately: the card echoes back what it searched for and tells the rep which identifier to ask for next, which is more useful than an apology.

states.label: Error
states.description: The sentinel shape. The service returns this instead of null so the card still mounts and can say what went wrong.

payload.error: Could not reach the customer profile service. Try again in a moment.
